title: Simulator head positions lie in encoded blocks
statement: Let $Gamma$ be a finite alphabet, let $N,kinmathbb{N}$, let $E$ inject the symbols of $Gamma$ together with blank into blocks of $N+1$ optional bits, and let $e:{0,1}hookrightarrowGamma$ be an embedding. For a machine $M$ over $Gamma$, a binary input $x$, a source configuration $c$ on its letterwise $e$-image, a time $tinmathbb{N}$, and a work tape $i$, there are $sle t+1$ and $jle N+1$ such that the simulator's head position on tape $i$ at time $t$ is $(N+1)$ times the source head position on tape $i$ at time $s$, plus $j$.
